about: Work in progress. Serum 1 presets in three collections: popular PresetShare presets (most liked, across genres and sound types), the EMP Famous 80s & 90s pack and the Loopsy Rave Vol. 1 & 2 packs (renders only). Each is rendered from its own MIDI part in Serum and, after conversion, in Vital. Same notes, same tempo, no normalization. MIDI cut at 30 s.
